name: pumpfun-launcher
description: Full-stack pump.fun token launcher — Vercel serverless, Neon Postgres, Jito/Solana deploy pipeline, optional RunPod vanity GPU worker

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.vercel-build: npm run build -w client && node scripts/sync-spa-dist.mjs
